findings.current: How much sincerity had been in the back of him as he left, with anger and bitterness hanging over him?
findings.defect: “Sincerity had been in the back of him” is an unnatural English collocation that obscures what So Gyo is trying to read from his departure.
findings.rationale: Keeps her focus on his retreating figure and her uncertainty about his sincerity while making the thought readable.
findings.replacement: How much of his sincerity had shown in his retreating back, beneath all that anger and bitterness?
